messages:
deploy-bot: Starting blue/green shift for service `router-edge` -> v3.2.1. Initiating 10% traffic probe for 15m. Change window: 2026-03-21 02:00-03:00 UTC. Release notes: https://redwood.docs/releases/v3.2.1. Deploy ID: rb-20260321-1799. Auto-rollback: 5xx rate >0.5% OR p95 latency delta >30%. Paging to @alex @priya @marc :bell:

alex: ack. I’ll watch p95 and 5xx. Will run a few sanity queries after ramp.

priya: pinned sessions for this release? we hit stickiness regressions last week.

marc: pinning routing config to session-cookie `rid` for 1h post-cutover. Doing it now. cc @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: routing pin set: `session_affinity=rid` duration=3600s

kai: alerting deck prepped. Added Grafana panels for `router-edge`: p95, p50, error_rate, 5xx_count. Paging thresholds: error_rate >0.3% for 2m OR p95 increase >25%.

priya: can we hold at 10% for 15m instead of 10m? 10m felt tight last time.

alex: fine with 15m — adjust the probe window.

deploy-bot: holding at 10% for 15m. Next step: ramp to 50% if checks pass. Auto-backout policy: immediate rollback to green variant on triggered thresholds. Manual override: `/deploy cancel rb-20260321-1799`

kai: real-time log sanity: tail router logs with `kubectl logs -l app=router-edge -f --since=10m` — watch for 502/504 patterns.

priya: :thumbsup:

alex: p95 looks stable at 12ms (baseline 11ms), error_rate 0.02% — all good so far.

deploy-bot: 15m probe complete. Metrics within bounds. Proceeding to 50% ramp in 2m. Notifying watchers.

priya: reminder to update release notes with config flag `enable_kv_cache_prefetch=true` and any known regressions.

marc: added note in release doc: https://redwood.docs/releases/v3.2.1 — can someone +1?

alex: +1. Also added explicit rollback_reason enum to monitoring tags.

deploy-bot: 50% ramp started. Expected duration: ~3m. Watch p95 and error_rate closely.

kai: incoming spike: eu-west region at t+1min shows 5xx_rate -> 0.8% on `router-edge-eu-west`. Drilling in.

marc: seeing increased backend 504s from `model-pool-3`. Checking upstream routing — looks like some requests are hitting a stale pool.

alex: if 5xx persists beyond 2m we should rollback that region. Initiating manual pause on ramp.

priya: switching eu-west back to green (v3.2.0) now as a regional mitigation.

deploy-bot: manual hold engaged. Traffic split adjusted: eu-west -> green (v3.2.0) 100%; global remainder remains 50% to v3.2.1. Infra notified.

kai: alert resolved after regional redirect. p95 normalized. I’ll keep monitoring for 20m.

alex: tagging this as a partial rollback for eu-west. If root cause is deployment config we’ll need a postmortem.

priya: FYI opened ticket for suspected TTL mismatch in cache layer: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1234

marc: follow-up actions: prune failing `model-pool-3` routes and add defensive `retry_on_504=true` for 30s to v3.2.1 rollout.

alex: agreed. Once fix goes in we can re-run eu-west bump. ETA ~45m.

deploy-bot: recorded action: partial rollback (eu-west); rollout paused. `/deploy status rb-20260321-1799`

kai: will annotate PagerDuty if escalation required. No full rollback for now.

priya: adding note to release page about the regional partial rollback and session pinning for 1h.

alex: when we reattempt, let’s do an eu-west shadow run for 30m before any gradual ramp.

priya: scheduling reattempt at 03:30 UTC with infra.

deploy-bot: thread closed for now. React with :white_check_mark: when action items are complete.
